**Change**: issue-214-secret-scrub-idintegrity (C1b — completes C1 memory-format work)
**Mode**: Strict TDD (RED→GREEN per unit, evidence below)
**Status**: 7/7 task groups complete. Ready for sdd-verify.

- [x] 1. Secret scrub: secret-scrub.mjs (pure) + engram.mjs#scrubMaterializedChunks/share() wiring + i18n
- [x] 2. Id-integrity hardening: store.mjs#rebuildIndex recomputes id via format.mjs#computeRecordId, fails closed with file:line
- [x] 3. Config migration 0.5.0 (governance.memorySecretPatterns / memorySecretAllowPatterns) + drift-guard test + brain-config.test.mjs ripple fix (0.4.0→0.5.0 hardcoded expectation)
- [x] 4. .gitattributes: appended `/.memory/records/*.jsonl merge=union` (built-in union driver) + managed-paths.mjs#RECORDS_UNION_MERGE_GITATTRIBUTES_LINE single-source constant + drift-guard test
- [x] 5. index.json → index.jsonl rename (cli.mjs real path, format.mjs/store.mjs comments, tests, issue-205 spec/design refs, C0 drafts)
- [x] 6. C0 doc-sync: corrected stale union-exclusion rationale in brain-drafts/memory-format.md + brain-drafts/adr-0017 (was: "single JSON object"; now: reindex replaces/reorders lines, regenerable, discard+reindex on conflict)
- [x] 7. Verification: npm test 951/951 green, brain:repo:check green, brain:nav green, i18n coverage green

## Files Changed
| File | Action | What Was Done |
|------|--------|----------------|
| brain/scripts/memory/lib/secret-scrub.mjs | Created | Pure fail-closed secret scanner: DEFAULT_SECRET_PATTERNS, resolveSecretConfig (additive), scanTextForSecrets (allowlist=only bypass), scrubChunkFile (gunzip+pretty-print+scan) |
| brain/scripts/memory/lib/secret-scrub.test.mjs | Created | 13 unit tests |
| brain/scripts/memory/backends/engram.mjs | Modified | share() now injectable-seam wired: _requireEngram→_export→scrubMaterializedChunks; scrubMaterializedChunks exported, independently testable (no engram/git dependency in tests) |
| brain/scripts/memory/backends/engram.share.test.mjs | Created | 10 tests covering orchestration + fail-closed propagation + no-bypass-flag guard |
| brain/scripts/memory/lib/store.mjs | Modified | rebuildIndex recomputes id via computeRecordId(record), throws `id mismatch at file:line` on divergence |
| brain/scripts/memory/lib/store.test.mjs | Modified | +2 tests (tampered id fails closed; legitimate record no false positive) + index.jsonl rename |
| brain/core/config-migrations.mjs | Modified | +0.5.0 migration (memorySecretPatterns defaults + memorySecretAllowPatterns empty default) |
| brain/scripts/lib/installer.test.mjs | Modified | +4 tests for 0.5.0 migration incl. drift-guard vs secret-scrub.mjs defaults |
| brain/scripts/lib/brain-config.test.mjs | Modified | Ripple fix: hardcoded latest schemaVersion assertion 0.4.0→0.5.0 |
| brain/core/managed-paths.mjs | Modified | +RECORDS_UNION_MERGE_GITATTRIBUTES_LINE constant |
| brain/scripts/lib/managed-paths.test.mjs | Modified | +2 tests (literal value + drift guard vs real .gitattributes) |
| .gitattributes | Modified | Appended `/.memory/records/*.jsonl merge=union` |
| brain/scripts/memory/cli.mjs | Modified | indexPath real filename → index.jsonl; comments updated |
| brain/scripts/memory/lib/format.mjs | Modified | index.json→index.jsonl in comments (3 spots) |
| brain/scripts/memory/lib/records-merge.integration.test.mjs | Modified | indexPath local var → index.jsonl |
| brain/scripts/i18n/en.mjs, es.mjs | Modified | +memory.share.secretFound key, both locales |
| openspec/changes/issue-201-memory-format/brain-drafts/memory-format.md | Modified | Corrected union-exclusion rationale + index.jsonl rename throughout |
| openspec/changes/issue-201-memory-format/brain-drafts/adr-0017-memory-format-owned-by-brain.md | Modified | Same correction + rename + amended date note |
| openspec/changes/issue-205-memory-format-lib/spec.md, design.md | Modified | index.jsonl rename + rename note |
| openspec/changes/issue-205-memory-format-lib/tasks.md | Modified | C1b section (6.1-8.2) marked [x], pointing to issue-214 |
| openspec/changes/issue-214-secret-scrub-idintegrity/{proposal,design,spec,tasks}.md | Created | Full SDD scaffold for this slice |

## TDD Cycle Evidence
| Unit | RED | GREEN | REFACTOR |
|------|-----|-------|----------|
| store.mjs id-integrity | tampered-id test failed (Missing expected exception) | computeRecordId comparison added, throws on mismatch | n/a |
| secret-scrub.mjs | import failed (module missing) | pure module implemented, 13/13 pass | n/a |
| engram.mjs share() wiring | import failed (scrubMaterializedChunks not exported) | wired scrubMaterializedChunks + share(), 10/10 pass | n/a |
| managed-paths.mjs constant | import failed (RECORDS_UNION_MERGE_GITATTRIBUTES_LINE not exported) | constant added, 2/2 new tests pass | n/a |
| config-migrations.mjs 0.5.0 | (implemented alongside tests — data/schema addition, no independent RED state beyond "field absent") | 4/4 new installer.test.mjs tests pass | n/a |

## Deviations from Design
None — implementation matches design.md decisions 1-6 exactly (scrub target = chunks pre-C2, shared computeRecordId reuse, index.jsonl rename, built-in union driver, additive migration + drift guard).

## Line budget
Counted (excluding **/*.test.mjs, openspec/changes/**, .memory/** per this repo's own governance.ignoreList convention): modified files diff = 181 insertions + 14 deletions = 195; new non-test file secret-scrub.mjs = 115 lines. Total = 310 counted lines — under the 400 budget, no split needed.

## Status
7/7 task groups complete (all checked in tasks.md). npm test 951/951 green. Ready for sdd-verify.
